name: Clarifin
summary: Clarifin is a web app that helps English-fluent Indonesian retail investors understand IDX-listed company financial documents. Users upload annual reports or financial statements and receive plain-English explanations, an AI-generated holistic score with reasoning, light valuation context, and a chat interface to ask follow-up questions.
description: Clarifin bridges the gap between complex IDX financial documents and the urban Indonesian professional who invests in IDX stocks but cannot read financial statements. Users upload a PDF — annual report, quarterly filing, balance sheet, cash flow, or income statement — and Clarifin returns a plain-English breakdown of the document, a holistic 1–10 health score with AI-generated reasoning, current financial ratios compared against sector benchmarks and multi-year trends, and an interactive chat interface for follow-up questions. Every AI-generated factual claim is traced back to a specific page in the source PDF, ensuring full transparency. The platform is built entirely on free-tier infrastructure (Vercel Hobby, Supabase, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Groq) to keep operating costs at zero at low traffic, making it a sustainable solo-built side project. All output is clearly labeled as analysis and explanation — not investment advice — with prominent disclaimers throughout the interface.

key_features.title: Plain-English Financial Explanation
key_features.feature: Uploads IDX financial documents (PDF) and generates a plain-English breakdown readable by non-finance professionals, with every claim cited back to a specific page in the source document.

key_features.title: AI Holistic Score
key_features.feature: Produces a 1–10 financial health score with structured reasoning powered by Gemini 2.5 Flash, giving investors a quick at-a-glance signal backed by transparent justification.

key_features.title: Valuation Context & Charts
key_features.feature: Fetches live IDX stock data via yahoo-finance2 and displays current ratios (P/E, P/B, dividend yield) against sector benchmarks and multi-year trends using Recharts.

key_features.title: RAG-Powered Chat Interface
key_features.feature: Lets users ask follow-up questions about the uploaded document using a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline built on Supabase pgvector and the Vercel AI SDK.
